guide_policy: The competition starter does not include a hidden flag. The hidden values below are presentation flags inferred from spoiler-sensitive story and surprise awards; confirm them against the supplied list if its schema is expanded.

sources.title: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.use: Roadmap, missable meditation warning, trophy steps.

sources.title: Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.use: Activity counts, locations, challenges and collection steps.

sources.title: GTA.guide — All GTA 6 trophies and achievements
sources.use: Cross-check for step details and uncertainty notes.

sources.title: Competition-provided trophy list
sources.use: Exact trophy names, descriptions and grades; source of truth for the list.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies; the platinum is awarded automatically when the set is complete.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Follow the opening story route and finish Gone Fishing. Story progress is retained for the postgame.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Advance the main story until the Chapter 1 completion award appears.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Continue the main story through the Chapter 2 finale. Make a manual save before moving on.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 3 story missions. No gold-medal conditions are listed for this award.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4’s main missions. Keep rotating manual saves for later cleanup.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. Free roam remains available afterward for cleanup.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the named story mission Breakfast Run.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist as part of the story.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish Headliners. This is a description-led step; no additional condition is stated.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the named story mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory in the main story.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: After the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work through its checklist. The guide reports partial targets across several categories; follow the in-game counter rather than assuming every map collectible is needed.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Accumulate 250 stunts across jumps, bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps. The map’s Exploration > Stunt Spots list helps locate discovered attempts; varied stunt types count toward the total.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try one of each activity type. The cited list names fishing, hunting, golf, shooting, pool, basketball, arcade, race win and stunt; use the activity counters to confirm.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold across 42 range challenges. Push Square points to Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero; check the map’s Activities > Shooting Ranges panel for locked events.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win once at each of the 14 Top Fun drone race locations. Track found events via Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones; some starts require an entry fee.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 distinct race events; repeating one race does not add a new win. Race locations and completion are tracked under Activities > Racing.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Accept Cal’s fishing request and beat his challenge. Push Square describes an early Parrotfish target over 2 kg; take a boat and fishing rod to the marked area and check the challenge prompt.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish a single arcade game. GTA.guide lists home TV games and Bang For Your Buck cabinets as options; the trophy description does not require a score threshold.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy’s mission strand through its final task. GTA.guide places the Lucia strand from Chapter 3 and names Puff Puff Pass as its ending; verify the strand counter in game.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton’s strand. GTA.guide describes seven Chapter 1 shipwreck recoveries, followed by his later return; the final mission named there is Maritime Disputes.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy’s five-job strand at Thrillbilly Mudclub, available after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. GTA.guide names Hometown Heroes as the final job.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight qualifying stranger strands. GTA.guide says the qualifying set is still being confirmed; use the trophy counter to validate each strand rather than counting every optional chain.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Progress Randy’s vehicle requests to the final mission. GTA.guide describes delivering 16 listed sports cars to his garage; WAiNK scans can identify requested vehicles.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Jason’s Tyrone strand. GTA.guide places it after Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3 and names Shut Down the Labs as the finale.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete the meditation at each of 18 spots and confirm the final zen animation. The first is at Jason’s house in Chapter 1 and may be missable; whether it is required is unresolved. Track Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Start Bret’s hunting jobs after Coffee Break in Chapter 2 and hunt a unique animal for him. GTA.guide says the exact animal requirement is unclear; the 100% checklist includes his 15 tasks.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete all cards in any three sets. Check Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards; collected cards may be sold without losing set progress.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK phone app. Locations include landmarks, oddities, sculptures and graffiti; track the total in Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. Open Progress > Challenges to see available objectives and counts.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner active, reach four wanted stars, then evade police until the search ends. GTA.guide notes this becomes available after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in succession while keeping the same wanted level active. Plan a route between shops before starting; the description supplies the condition, with no named shop route verified.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 distinct vehicles by entering or scanning them. Track new models in Progress > Vehicles; discovery should accumulate naturally during story and exploration.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Build Combat Focus, then activate it when at least five enemies are in range and take them down before the effect ends. This step follows the supplied description; no location is verified.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Trigger an unscheduled departure at VCIA. The provided description does not explain the interaction, so the exact method is unverified; revisit the airport during free roam and inspect available prompts.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is intentionally cryptic and no verified trigger is cited here. Keep this for free-roam cleanup and test tank-related challenges while monitoring the trophy notification.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without raising detection. Scout entrances and exits first, then leave unseen; the exact store and approach are not specified in the provided description.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Complete five bank vault robberies and escape each time. Keep count in the robbery progress panel; GTA.guide lists vault robberies among the 100% categories as well.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and survive the escape. The trophy description gives the full condition; no route or truck spawn is verified by the consulted sources.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Visit every region until all 52 areas of Leonida are discovered. Use the in-game map and regional exploration counter to spot gaps.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Complete an illegal-operation robbery for each of the nine gangs. Record which crews are done; the supplied description gives the count but not locations.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Order a cocktail at a venue on Ocean Beach with a view. The exact venue is not confirmed by the sources consulted; try beachfront bars and wait for the trophy prompt.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Break out of a vehicle showroom by smashing through it. The description supplies the setup, but a verified showroom name or vehicle is not available in the consulted sources.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and complete a bowling action. The precise follow-through requirement is unclear from the description alone.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The supplied description is cryptic and consulted guides do not confirm its trigger. Keep it visible in cleanup and record the event when the award appears.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices during play and check the trophy progress counter. The exact action is not stated in the supplied description, so no specific scene is claimed here.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The description implies succeeding on a repeated attempt, but does not identify the activity. Retry an activity after a failed first attempt; exact trigger remains unverified.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness an unusual event during exploration. The description alone does not identify a location or event; revisit optional points of interest and check for a trophy notification.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: While driving beside a target, use a melee attack to knock them down. This is a description-led method; no vehicle or target location is verified.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder marked bills through contacts until the total reaches $250,000. Track the amount received rather than the face value collected; the description does not identify a contact.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a combined $100,000 in shops. GTA.guide notes spending at any shop contributes; purchases are cumulative, so use the progress counter to track the total.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all eight garage properties. Check the property listings across the map and revisit the total after each purchase.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles through the Scooter Bros app. Complete one registration at a time and confirm each is reflected in its counter.
